name: Jekamiah
overview: Jekamiah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified uniquely as the son of Shallum. His mention in Scripture is brief and does not include additional notes or narrative details beyond his lineage. This establishes him as part of the genealogical record important to the people of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Jekamiah means 'YHWH will establish,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to God's providence. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:41, is not noted as being given directly by God but carries a significant reminder of divine establishment.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jekamiah as the son of Shallum and the grandson of Elishama, situating him within a known family line. These relationships are clearly stated in 1 Chronicles 2:41, providing a concise genealogical context without further familial details.
scriptureSignificance: Jekamiah's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, which are foundational for understanding the lineage and heritage of God's chosen people. Although no specific actions or events are attributed to him, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving the descendants of Judah. This genealogical mention contributes to the broader biblical narrative of God's covenantal promises through the tribe of Judah.
